name: proofline
description: Evidence-first engineering decision memory with deterministic stale-decision checks.

interface.shortDescription: Trace decisions to exact, versioned evidence
interface.longDescription: Create and review evidence-backed engineering decisions, preserve exact cited spans, verify portable evidence packages, and detect when cited source evidence has changed.
defaultPrompt: Document this engineering decision with exact evidence.
Check whether the evidence behind this decision changed.
Verify and explain this Decision Evidence Package.
